status: Released for a first test print as one complete set of four parts, sized for the measured 13.35 mm square tube. Geometry checks pass; physical fit, grip and print accuracy are unverified.
approval: The user approved the clamp-and-enclosure concept on 2026-11-02 (relayed by the coordinator). On 2026-11-03 the user gave the tube as 13.35 mm per flat side (a correction of an earlier 13.35 cm) and asked for the case mount to fit it with sufficient clearance.

source.commit: The commit that adds this checkpoint.

clamp-u.stl.part: Clamp U with the dovetail tongue, for the 13.35 mm square tube
clamp-u.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end, tube opening vertical, dovetail tongue on the back; as exported.

clamp-bar.stl.orientation: Flat, with the four screw-head recesses facing up; as exported.

enclosure-back.stl.part: Enclosure back with the dovetail channel, Pi case lips, PCA9685 wing and tie tab
enclosure-back.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as exported. Add a 5 mm brim.
enclosure-back.stl.supports: Under the dovetail block only: it starts 22 mm above the bed and sticks out 9 mm. Support on build plate only; keep supports out of the dovetail channel.

pi-case-30mm.stl.part: Pi case, 30 mm deep (already shortened in the CAD), from the OMT Raspberry Pi 5 case
pi-case-30mm.stl.orientation: Floor on the bed, open side up; as exported.
pi-case-30mm.stl.supports: none; the wall openings print as bridges, the longest 54 mm

print_pack.note: Packed on 2026-11-03 for the first test print. Its STLs, images, README and license are byte-identical to this checkpoint; it carries its own manifest with the same STL hashes.

print_settings.supports: Enclosure back only, under the dovetail block; none for the other parts

estimate.method: Not sliced. Printed volume from the model: a 1.4 mm shell plus 40 % infill, 117 cm3 in total, PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 8 mm3/s (fast current printer) to 3 mm3/s (older printer).

hardware.item: M3 x 16 mm socket-head screw (20 mm also fits)
hardware.check: validate() fits M3 screws from 15.7 to 20.7 mm on a 13.35 mm tube

hardware.item: M3 hex nut, 5.5 mm across flats
hardware.use: 4 in the U side slots, 1 on the lock pin
Lock pin through the 32.6 mm enclosure block, below the tongue
Front face of the enclosure back, through the case floor and the Pi, into the AI HAT+ spacers

hardware.item: M2.5 x 16 mm spacer, supplied with the AI HAT+ [@raspberrypi2024AiHatBrief]
hardware.use: Pi to AI HAT+; assumed threaded at both ends
PCA9685 into the printed 2.4 mm pilots; a longer screw comes through the wing toward the case

hardware.item: Zip tie, up to 4.8 mm wide
hardware.use: Wire bundle through the tie-tab slots

measure_before_printing: Tube: square, 12.5 to 14 mm per side (measured 13.35 mm).
Bare tube: 50 mm for the clamp, with nothing fixed to any of its four faces.
Space: the mount is 121 mm tall, 85 mm wide and 85 mm deep; it hangs behind the tube from 30.5 mm below the clamp to 40.5 mm above it.

envelope_mm.frame: Clamp frame: origin on the tube axis at the clamp lower end; tube faces at +/-6.675.

interfaces.tube: 13.35 mm square tube; 0.4 mm clearance at the sides and back; the bar closes a 1.5 mm gap at the front
interfaces.dovetail: Tongue root 16, tip 22, depth 6, height 50; mates the enclosure back channel (0.3 mm clearance)

robot_clearance: Not assessed. Only the mount size (envelope_mm) and the bare tube length are given.
not_established: tube size: one measurement of a flat side
printed dimensions, the tube and dovetail fits, the nut slots and the M2.5 threads in the PCA9685 bosses
clamp grip and slip resistance on the tube
whether one M3 pin holds the enclosure while the robot moves
Motor HAT spacer height (11 mm estimated) and the AI HAT+ spacer threads
wiring: drawn schematically; cable lengths and the bundle route
Pi 5 and AI HAT+ temperatures in the case
print time and filament: estimated, not sliced

removed_on_2026-11-03.reason: The user asked for superseded models to be deleted, not kept or renamed.
